done.text: Kiebitz at the edge. Tanks in the streets on this bank. Out.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. The town is 300 metres east. Bridge in its centre. Out.

done.text: West bank clear. The bridge. Out.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Clear the streets to the river. Out.

done.text: Bridge taken. Armour on the east road. Hold. Out.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. On the bridge. Nothing of theirs within 200 metres while you hold it. Out.

done.text: First attack beaten off. More behind it. Out.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Three tanks coming down the east road. Hold the bridge. Out.
Kiebitz, Adler. Second attack, three tanks, east road. Out.

done.text: Kiebitz, Adler. No more armour. The bridge is ours. Out.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Tanks still in the town. Destroy them. Out.

note: Spring bridge test map (tools/worldgen/spring_bridge.py). Places are the map's own geometry: the town's west edge, its west-bank streets, the bridge deck, the east road the counterattacks come down. The garrison is the street platoons, one loop on each bank; the counterattacks are platoons released on the east road when the bridge is taken. A generated test map, not a recorded engagement. Played from the playtest menu as "Bridge: Take and Hold" with the living AI crew aboard (2026-11-08).
order: Panzer 231. Full crew aboard, you command. The camp and the half-track are behind you on the west road.
The road bridge in the town is intact. Soviet tanks hold both banks of the town.
Take the bridge and hold it. Expect armour from the east once you are on it. Destroy every tank.
